text_blocks.snippet: Yes, there is help available for COVID long haulers, including both medical and community resources. Long COVID is a recognized condition with ongoing symptoms and potential disability, and support is available to help manage it.

list.title: Medical Care:
list.snippet: If you suspect you have Long COVID, it's crucial to consult with your healthcare provider. They can assess your symptoms, provide guidance on management, and connect you with specialists if needed.

list.title: Community-Based Resources:
list.snippet: Organizations like the Administration for Community Living (ACL) offer resources to help individuals with Long COVID navigate daily life. These resources can include assistance with transportation, personal care, and access to vaccinations.

list.title: Disability Rights:
list.snippet: The Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) and the Department of Justice (DOJ) have provided guidance indicating that some individuals with Long COVID may be considered disabled under civil rights laws, entitling them to protections against discrimination.

list.title: Federal Government Support:
